  • Method Details

    • setShelves

      public void setShelves(Game game)
      Sets the view of the correct number of shelves in the board
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object representing the current game.

    • initializeBoard

      public void initializeBoard(Game game)
      Initializes the game board by updating the ImageView nodes in the boardPane with the corresponding tiles from the game's board. Also sets up event handling for mouse clicks on the ImageView nodes.
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object representing the current game.

    • resetFalse

      public void resetFalse()
      Resets the clickedCells array to false and restores the opacity of all ImageViews in the boardPane. This method is typically used to reset the state of the game board.

    • initializeClientShelf

      public void initializeClientShelf(Game game, Client client)
      Initializes the client's shelf in the game by updating the ImageView nodes in the shelfGrid with the corresponding tiles from the client's shelf.
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object representing the current game.
      client - The Client object representing the client whose shelf is being initialized.

    • initializeOtherShelves

      public void initializeOtherShelves(Game game, LinkedList<String> playerOrder)
      Initializes the shelves of the other players in the game by updating the ImageView nodes in the respective shelfGrids with the corresponding tiles from each player's shelf. It also sets the names of the other players on UI elements.
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object representing the current game.
      playerOrder - A LinkedList containing the players in the game.

    • initializeShelf3

      private void initializeShelf3(Game game, LinkedList<String> playerOrder)
      Initializes the shelf for the third player in the game by updating the ImageView nodes in the shelfGrid3 with the corresponding tiles from the player's shelf. It also sets the name of the third player on the client3 UI element.
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object representing the current game.
      playerOrder - A LinkedList containing the order of the players in the game.

    • handleCellClick

      private void handleCellClick(int row, int col, Game game)
      Handles the click event on a cell in the game board. Updates the visual state of the clicked cell and manages the selection of tiles. Also updates the visibility of the continueButton based on the current selection state.
      Parameters:
      row - The row index of the clicked cell.
      col - The column index of the clicked cell.
      game - The Game object representing the current game.

    • getTile

      public void getTile()
      Method used to set the tiles in the correct format and give them to the manager thread

    • handleConfirmation

      public void handleConfirmation()
      Handles the confirmation Button when the player has chosen the tiles

    • updateContinueButtonVisibility

      private void updateContinueButtonVisibility()
      When more than a cell is selected this method sets the visibility of the confirmation button as true

    • disableView

      public void disableView()
      Disables and hides the columns in the view. This method sets disable and visible properties of each column in the view to false.

    • ableView

      public void ableView()
      Enables and shows the columns in the view. This method sets disable and visible properties of each column in the view to true.

    • insertInColumn0

      public void insertInColumn0()
      Inserts a value into column 0 of the view. This method puts the value 0 into the queue for further processing. It also disables and hides the columns in the view.

    • insertInColumn1

      public void insertInColumn1()
      Inserts a value into column 1 of the view. This method puts the value 1 into the queue for further processing. It also disables and hides the columns in the view.

    • insertInColumn2

      public void insertInColumn2()
      Inserts a value into column 2 of the view. This method puts the value 2 into the queue for further processing. It also disables and hides the columns in the view.

    • insertInColumn3

      public void insertInColumn3()
      Inserts a value into column 3 of the view. This method puts the value 3 into the queue for further processing. It also disables and hides the columns in the view.

    • insertInColumn4

      public void insertInColumn4()
      Inserts a value into column 4 of the view. This method puts the value 4 into the queue for further processing. It also disables and hides the columns in the view.

    • displayAchievement

      public void displayAchievement(String nick, String username, int objectiveNumber)
      Displays an achievement message for a specific user and objective number.
      Parameters:
      nick - The nickname of the current user.
      username - The username of the user who achieved the objective.
      objectiveNumber - The number of the objective achieved.

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the current view or dialog, hiding the common object and removing any visual effects.

    • showLeaderboard

      public void showLeaderboard(org.json.JSONArray rank)
      Displays the leaderboard with the given rank data.
      Parameters:
      rank - The JSONArray containing the rank data.

    • exitButton

      public void exitButton()
      Sets up the exit button functionality. When the exit button is clicked or the window is closed, the application will be terminated.

    • startNewGame

      public void startNewGame()
      Starts a new game by adding a "true" value to the queue.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - If the thread is interrupted while adding the value to the queue.

    • setTransition

      public void setTransition()
      Sets the translation transition for the columns. Each column will be animated using a translate transition. Call this method to start the animation for the columns.

    • animateColumn

      private void animateColumn(javafx.scene.image.ImageView column)
      Animates the specified column using a translate transition. The column will move vertically in a continuous animation loop.
      Parameters:
      column - The ImageView representing the column to animate.
